messages:
marta: Heads up — we have 6 GPUs in euw-cluster showing recurring Xid 63 + ECC spike patterns this morning. I'm opening RMAs but need depot swap ETA and spare routing. Affected: euw-cluster-03:gpu[2,5], euw-cluster-06:gpu0. Serial list below. Who can coordinate pickup window and escrow flag?

liam: On it. Priority? customer-facing infra or internal background?

marta: Priority = HOT (customer SLA). Mark courier 24h if possible. Ticket: VS-31244 (created).

liam: Uploading manifest now. Will set region tag europe-only.

liam: ```
serial,slot,node
GPUEW-000187,2,euw-cluster-03
GPUEW-000191,5,euw-cluster-03
GPUEW-000203,0,euw-cluster-06
GPUEW-000210,1,euw-cluster-06
GPUEW-000222,3,euw-cluster-09
GPUEW-000227,0,euw-cluster-11
```

warehouse-bot: Manifest received and queued. Pickup window requested: Wed 09:00-12:00 UTC. Carrier queue ID: CK1. Waybill will be VS-31244-CK1. :package: 

vendor-ops: Vendor ack'd receipt of VS-31244. Confirming depot-swap vs advance spare drop-ship. Depot swap requires escrow hold on our side — please set `rma_escrow=true`.

ops-manager: @liam please set escrow flag and escalate to Premium SLA routing.

liam: Set `rma_escrow=true` on ticket VS-31244 and added tag `priority:24h` and `region:europe-only`.

sre-oncall: I'll schedule node drains 23:00 UTC tonight for euw-cluster-03 and -06. Plan: cordon -> migrate workloads -> GPU drain -> power down. ETA complete 60m per node.

marta: Note for capacity: we'll reduce batch sizes on affected pools and failover low-priority jobs to other regions where latency permits. Finance: replacement policy charge?

finance: If spares are consumed from Dedicated spare pool we'll charge to SPARE-DEDICATED; drop-ship cost uplift goes to cost-center infra-overhead. Document costs on VS-31244.

vendor-ops: Depot-swap ETA: 48-72h after pickup due to current vendor backlog. If you need <24h, we can request express drop-ship from vendor in SG/US but cost ~x1.8. Confirm?

marta: Accepting 48-72h for now. We'll implement routing/workarounds. If backlog increases, we'll revisit express.

alex: Added serial-recon rules to ticket: `recon_mode=strict`, `return_window=14d`. Also added follow-up checklist: serial scan on return, firmware diff check, tag as DOA if ECC persists.

liam: Tracking link (carrier): https://carrier.example/track/VS-31244-CK1 — will update when pickup confirmed.

warehouse-bot: Pickup confirmed by carrier: Wed 09:45 UTC. Waybill: VS-31244-CK1-0945.

vendor-ops: Vendor ETA update: pickup->depot ingestion ~24h, depot QA queue 24-48h. Expect replacement dispatch after QA.

marta: Good. I'll update the incident page and ops-runbook: reduce batch, enable fallback. Will post post-mortem if we see repeat failures. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

liam: cc @ops-manager — will monitor tracker and reopen if ETA slips beyond 72h.

ops-manager: Acknowledged. Keep me posted.

marta: Closing the coordination thread here; follow-ups will be on VS-31244.
